name: Build daily TVM overdue CSV
description: Weekdays at 12 and 3 PM ET, turns each new TVM dashboard (SLA_Flow_Stock_YYYY-MM-DD.html) in SharePoint into tvm-overdue-YYYY-MM-DD.csv for the listed people and uploads it. Polls since the SharePoint OAuth2 credential only works with SharePoint node v1.

nodes.name: Set SharePoint host and people
nodes.notes: Fill in before the first run. sharepointHost: e.g. contoso.sharepoint.com. dashboardFolderPath and csvFolderPath: the folder paths inside each site's Documents library, e.g. Reports/TVM/2026/Daily (leave out "Shared Documents"). people: names as they appear in the dashboard's Assigned To column (letter case and extra spaces don't matter). The placeholder names only produce header-only CSVs.

nodes.name: List CSVs already uploaded
nodes.notes: Lists csvFolderPath (from the first step) on the site picked in "Upload CSV". HTTP Request because SharePoint node v1 has no list-files operation; it uses the same Microsoft SharePoint OAuth2 API credential.

nodes.name: List TVM folder files
nodes.notes: Lists dashboardFolderPath (from the first step) on the site picked in "Download dashboard". Runs once even when the CSV listing came back in several pages.

nodes.name: Keep dashboards needing a CSV
nodes.notes: Keeps SLA_Flow_Stock_YYYY-MM-DD.html files dated in the last 7 days whose tvm-overdue CSV is missing, or older than the dashboard (a re-upload). The 7-day window stops edits or moves of old dashboards from rebuilding their CSVs.

nodes.name: Download dashboard
nodes.notes: SharePoint node v1 on purpose: in n8n 2.44.5, v2 cannot use the Microsoft SharePoint OAuth2 API credential. Only pick the TVM site here (Site > From list). Leave Parent Folder as root and File as it is: the folder comes from dashboardFolderPath and the file from the filter step.

nodes.name: Extract tickets to CSV text
nodes.notes: Reads only the "All teams" tables (Active, and Ready for Validation & Pending/PER) and keeps the people from "Set SharePoint host and people". Fails on a layout change instead of uploading a wrong CSV.

nodes.name: Make CSV file
nodes.notes: Adds a UTF-8 byte-order mark so Excel shows the — in Days Over correctly.

nodes.name: Upload CSV
nodes.notes: SharePoint node v1 (see "Download dashboard"). Only pick the destination site here. Leave Parent Folder as root: the CSV goes to csvFolderPath from the first step. A file with the same name is replaced.

nodes.name: Build error message

assignments.name: teamsPayload

nodes.notes: Kept as its own step so test runs (which never execute the Teams post) can check the exact message, and so every run log shows what was sent.

nodes.name: Send error to my DM

parameters.url: <__PLACEHOLDER_VALUE__DM webhook URL from Teams, without the &sig=... part__>

nodes.notes: Setup: URL = the DM webhook URL from Teams Workflows with its "&sig=..." part removed. The sig value goes in the Query Auth credential (Name: sig, Value: the sig value).

parameters.content: ### Fill in before the first run

nodeGroups.name: Find dashboards to convert
nodeGroups.description: Lists both SharePoint folders, then keeps SLA_Flow_Stock dashboards from the last 7 days whose CSV is missing or older than the dashboard.

nodeGroups.name: Build and upload the CSV
nodeGroups.description: Downloads each dashboard, writes the listed people's tickets in the TVM Tickets layout, and uploads tvm-overdue-YYYY-MM-DD.csv over any old copy.

nodeGroups.name: Alert my DM
nodeGroups.description: Runs when any step above fails: posts the failed step, the error and a link to the run to the Teams DM.
